pages.title: Cardinal Ore
pages.text: Rather than order, this ore measures size. Its crystals pair up perfectly with one another, unless they come from a larger infinity, in which case some are always left over. It is heavier than it looks, and denser in every sense.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Next to ordinal veins I found a second kind of ore that refused to be sorted, only compared. Diagonal arguments on the samples always left a remainder, the clear mark of a larger cardinal.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the Transfinite Hierarchy (mine it for its drop).
